fix(runtime): release leases for SCM phases

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-51
  description: |-
    Coordinate runnable capacity at every typed Agent/SCM handoff. Agent-to-SCM transitions now release held leases with store-derived not-applicable evidence in the handoff transaction, while resolved SCM-to-Agent activation validation accepts every typed SCM source.
    
    Startup reconciliation now treats the locked current executing SCM operation as valid not-applicable runtime authority without requiring an Attention row, preserving the executing owner instead of forcing Recovery Required. Add PostgreSQL regression coverage and align the runtime specification and OpenWiki architecture context.
